t: This is Florin Court, an Art Deco, Streamline Moderne block of flats on the eastern side of Charterhouse Square, in Smithfield. It's Grade II listed, and its curved, sleek lines stand out against the older buildings around the square. It's a residential building, so people live behind those windows. Take a moment to look at the shape of the facade and how it contrasts with the quiet, historic square in front of it.
